'''Breathing suits''' were used to enable the wearer to breathe in underwater environments. Breathing suits ran on [[Power cell/Legends|power-cells]] and came in many different variants, all of which included a breathing apparatus and diving mask.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], breathing suits were used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents during operations on [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. The Rebel spaceboat [[Explorer (space boat)|''Explorer'']] was known to include six breathing suits as part of its stored equipment.
